biotools.summary: SciJava Ops is a framework for Fiji and other platforms that enables algorithm implementations to be declared as plugins with a uniform interface, facilitating streamlined workflows and easy extensibility. It uses declarative operations to adapt available algorithms on demand and offers benchmarking data demonstrating minimal impact on performance.
